slides.headline: Sign in and verify
slides.body: Sign in at trade.tokennest.com and complete verification (once).

slides.headline: Choose what to sell
slides.body: Choose the asset and the amount you want to sell.

slides.headline: See your quote
slides.body: You see a quote — the price and the total you'll receive, before you confirm.

slides.headline: Send to the address shown
slides.body: Copy and paste it; check the first and last characters.

slides.headline: Receive your CAD
slides.body: Once the transfer is confirmed on the network, your CAD is sent to you by Interac e-Transfer or to your bank account.

slides.headline: No account balance is held for you at any step.
slides.body: It's your crypto until it's sent, then it's your dollars.
